tagline: Think, decide and talk it through
homeIntro: A participatory activity to compare what people know, match sentences with roles or uncover a group's values and priorities.
knowledgeDescription: Bid for the statements you believe are correct and defend your decisions.
valuesDescription: Share out a limited budget among the ideas that matter most to the group.
rolesDescription: Bid for sentences linked to different roles: a correct match scores points and a wrong one loses them.
privacyLine: No sign-up · direct connection · ephemeral data
title: Title
titlePlaceholder: E.g.: Key ideas for an inclusive school
instructionsPlaceholder: Briefly explain the aim of the activity…
explanationPlaceholder: It will be shown when the answer is revealed…
pasteHelp: One sentence per line. They will be added at the end.
showBreakdown: Show each participant's allocation in the results
preparedText: This link holds the whole setup. Save it to run the activity another day.
urlLongWarning: The link is long. Check that the platform you share it on does not cut it short.
validationTitle: Add a title and at least two complete sentences.
validationRoles: Add a title, at least two named roles and two assigned sentences.
roleDefinitionsHelp: Create as many roles as you need. Teams will be shared out among them and you can change the assignment before starting.
roleExplanationPlaceholder: Optional explanation shown when the bid is settled…
connectionError: Could not connect. Check the code and try again.
waitingForHost: Wait for the facilitator to start the activity.
planningHelp: Look through all the sentences and decide which ones are worth bidding for.
